name: eval-e07
intent: 大片雪花缓缓飘落，轻微左右飘动，深灰蓝背景

params: Box emitter distributes snow across the frame width
Emit just above the top edge so flakes enter naturally
Wide emitter covers beyond both screen edges
Sustained moderate density while keeping individual large flakes readable
Low initial velocity keeps the snowfall calm
Uniform launch variation prevents rigid parallel paths
Long lifetime lets flakes travel through the full composition
Glow Sphere gives each white flake a naturally soft edge
Clearly readable large snowflake scale rather than fine dust
Strong size variation creates foreground and background flake depth
White flakes remain visible against the dark background
Subtle opacity variance avoids a uniform synthetic particle field
Set Color to At Birth so the white color setting is active
Normal compositing preserves opaque snow instead of luminous additive dots
Gentle positive gravity drives a slow downward fall
Air resistance slows movement and enables wind-driven drifting
Light horizontal wind gives the snowfall its lateral drift
Turbulence adds slight natural side-to-side wandering
Large turbulence scale makes broad graceful drift instead of jitter
Low-complexity turbulence keeps the movement soft and uncluttered
expressions: Slowly varies the horizontal wind so flakes gently wander left and right
Very slow emitter sweep prevents the falling field from feeling mechanically fixed

params: A restrained bloom softens flake edges without washing out the scene
Small glow radius creates delicate halos around large flakes
Threshold limits glow mainly to the bright white snow
Feathered threshold keeps the snow glow natural
Retain the crisp white flake cores beneath the soft bloom

_rationale: Trapcode Particular produces a wide field of large, white, softly edged particles with gravity for downward motion and gated wind/turbulence for gentle lateral wandering. A restrained highlight-only Deep Glow keeps the snow soft and visible while the dark grey-blue comp background remains clean and atmospheric.
